title: Native constructibility of an integral tensor extension
statement: Let ell be prime and X a Noetherian finite-dimensional scheme with ell invertible in every stalk. Use the native section-ring and section-module functor S of [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data], with its specified commutative, additive and finite-exact structures. Let E be a finite intermediate field of PadicAlgCl ell, let E_small be its canonical size transport, and let C be any coefficient presentation for the specified embedding E_small into PadicAlgCl ell. For an integral constructible complex L over E_small [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] and a native derived object M, if S(M) is isomorphic to derived extension of L along C.integralMap, then M has bounded native constructible cohomology.

proof.text: Localize at the uniformizer and extend to the locally finite algebraic-closure coefficient. Flatness and the normalized tensor comparison identify the displayed derived tensor with these local scalar extensions. The finite perfect complexes become bounded complexes of finite-dimensional coefficient spaces; their cohomology is finite free on pro-etale covers of each stratum. There are finitely many strata, so the bounds are uniform.

lean.statement:
theorem nativeIntegralTensor_constructible
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ n)]
    [Fact (∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))]
    [IsCommMonObj (abRing l X)] [(sections l X).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (sections l X)] [PreservesFiniteColimits (sections l X)]
    (E : Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    (C : CoefficientPresentation l X (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) (embedding l E))
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) X)
    (M : DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l X))
    (e : (sections l X).mapDerivedCategory.obj M ≅
      (pbcDerivedExtend (C.integralMap l X)).obj K.obj) :
    ProEtale.DerivedCategory.boundedAdicConstructible l X M
